profile.headline: Software Engineer IV @ Paychex
profile.summary: I am a Full Stack Engineer with a foundation in Design and User Experience. I specialize in refining and optimizing code for maintainability, scalability, and reusability. My attention for detail and pattern recognition enhances the efficiency of the solutions I design and develop. I've taken projects from conception to deployment, collaborating with teams of varying sizes. Ensuring that the requirements of all Users and stakeholders are addressed.

positions.title: Senior Front End Engineer
positions.description:
+  Lead collaboration with teams, managers, and stakeholders to accelerate development of business needs.
+  Translate information hierarchy into software architecture from the user’s perspective.
+  Used technical ability and creativity to improve current user experience design and performance driven development of user interfaces.
+  Communicate business proposals to teams with the ability of breaking down complex issues into simple technical solutions and requirements.
+  Define and communicate performance and workflow efficiency patterns for development teams.
+  Mentor designers, developers, and product managers in how to approach “User First” experiences.
+ Built front end architecture of software applications using RXJS within Angular framework.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
+  Operated within Agile methodology to develop software components.
+  Contributed to a culture of continuous improvement.
+  Collaborate in compiling legacy .NET systems to the Angular Framework.
+  Refactor large-scale style libraries into Scalable Modular Architecture.
+  Daily focus of developing user-centered functionality within WCAG 2.0 compliance.
+  Refactor legacy codebases to utilize custom reusable component systems.
+  Contribute to full stack of software applications.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
+  Develop websites for clients in an agency atmosphere.
+  Built CMS sites using WordPress, Expression Engine, and CRAFT.
+  Introduced automation (npm, grunt.js, and gulp.js), BEM/SMACSS styling, architecture, and GIT version control into team workflows.
+  Worked with Responsive Frameworks including Bootstrap, Foundation, and Skeleton.
+  Audited existing code for best practices for performance optimization.
+  Refactored legacy code into Mobile First strategies with Responsive Design.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
+  Design, develop, and create content for responsive websites for small to large businesses.
+  Implemented CMS and Ecommerce dynamic sites using WordPress and WooCommerce.
+  Create SEO & Marketing campaigns through Google Analytics and MOZ.
+  Built ecommerce website and created a web marketing strategy which grossed $220k in 2nd month of going live.
+  Developed PWA to solve communication issues with the Sales & Scheduling Departments.

positions.title: Digital Media Designer
positions.description:
+  Created graphics, ads, and animations of modeling shoots for major modeling markets.
+  Daily editing of .RAW files using Lightroom & Photoshop for ad campaigns.
+  Created web pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, with custom CMS.
